Results.ReviewText:
I am a very loyal Weber owner.  I have bought and used only Weber grills for over 40 years.  This summer, when I decided to purchase a gas grill to complement the Weber charcoal grill at our log cabin up near the top of New Hampshire, I was determined to get a Weber, even though that meant driving two hours each way to find a store that had a suitable one.
   A friend and I put the grill together, only to discover that the door could not be properly installed because there was no hole in the bottom  platform where one was very obviously needed.  
   Fortunately my friend was very handy with tools and we were able to purchase several metal drill bits and the right nut and bolt to install the door.
   But I was extremely surprised and disappointed that Weber would sell a product with such a blatant flaw in it.  
   Also, the round hole in the bottom plate seems to be in the wrong location, as it forces the gas tank to awkwardly sit at an angle when secured to the scale.
   The grill, of course, works beautifully otherwise.
Results.Title: Wrong bottom plate?

Results.ReviewText: Like many others have noted there appears to be a defect in the manufacturing of this model. Despite being covered and used lightly, I also experienced rusting on the legs, door, and bottom section of the grill after only a few years. Eventually the bottom where the wheels attach will rust out causing the grill to fall over and a potential safety hazard. The rusting started in the 2nd year. I reached out to Weber in year 4 but was told those parts are not under warranty. I have attached photos from that time. Today (year 6) the grill is even worse and I expect a wheel to fall off any day now, hopefully while not being used! Can not recommend Weber over substantially cheaper models, the value and quality is not there anymore.
Results.Title: Disappointing quality and warranty

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace the same model that I purchased in 2008. After foolishly spending way too much money to replace the worn out parts on my old grill, I sprung for a new one because the rebuild didn't work out very well. The new grill is fine. It came with bent sides so I immediately called Weber. They sent the left side immediately but the right side took almost a month to arrive. Easy assembly. I don't like the pretty stainless steel folding trays on the sides. Stainless looks great when new but degrades in appearance very quickly. I liked the non folding plastic shelves on my old Spirit and those handles incorporated a handle to pull the grill around with and small storage compartments on the front of them. I like the new battery opp starter although anything with a battery is prone to fail. The old clicker style starter was pretty much foolproof. I like the tank storage inside the cabinet. I hope that the bottom of my cabinet doesn't rot out like the last one.
Results.Title: Weber 2 Burner Propane Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill heats up quickly with nice even heat.   This is the second Weber grill I have owned.  Both were nice quality!   I would like to have a griddle component for this grill but have not found one yet.  Do you make one?
Results.Title: Excellent Quality

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I purchased this grill after a lot of research on what the industry had available. We hadn't owned a gas grill in a very long time and decided that we wanted to try another one. We had been using a smoker instead. We looked at pricing, convenience, brand recognition, design and ease of use. We could not have made a better choice than the Spirit E-210 grill by Weber. We now cook more outside than we do inside. We purchased several new accessories that make cooking out easier and more fun. The Weber app is also a wealth of knowledge. There are cooking tips and recipes galore. We will certainly be trying many of these out over the next several months. We don't stop cooking out when the weather turns cold ! I had an occassion to contact customer service and it had to rank up in the top two experiences I have had with other customer service reps. Emily was not only very professional but a real pleasure to work with. I felt like I was dealing with a friend. If you are in the market for a new grill, I would highly recommend that you take a look at this one. You will not be disappointed !
Results.Title: 1st Gas Grill in 20 years !

Results.ReviewText: I had this E-210 for a couple months now. I am very happy with its performance and features. Initially I was looking for an E-310, but due to supply and availability in Mexico, I ended up with the 210. No regrets, I thought 2 burners would be enough, wrong!!! That thing gets “Smokin’” hot fast and holds the heat very well. Low and slow, to char broil, it is handled easily.
Results.Title: Very happy!

Results.ReviewText: I may not have used it enough yet to to have a reason to rate it lower.  So far it meets or exceeds expectations I had for it.  Takes up small space but has very good size grill space.  Great heat control.  Durability looks promising.  My one recommendation for improvement is to have a special durable, tough surface on the bottom edge of the door.  Getting a full bottle of propane inside without scratching the paint surface on the bottom edge proved impossible for me.  I will use a mat of some type in the future but I scraped paint with the first bottle.
Results.Title: Great Grill w one recommendation

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.
